meta_description:
3,359 likes, 27 comments - kayla_itsines on October 11, 2026: "You know that friend who keeps saying they want to train with you but one of you loves strength and the other loves Pilates...

Send them this. A mix of both so there’s no more excuses 😉🤍

4 rounds of:
Alternating single leg taps - 8 reps each side
Glute bridge march - 8 reps each side
Russian twist - 8 reps each side
Weighted jackknife - 8 reps each side
Side plank & oblique crunch - 6 each side".
